description: Carried both the 3 Sqn red band and the 8 Sqn shachihoko plus a shark mouth on the tanks until 2019 when everything but the shachihoko was removed
One of the four T-1Bs that made the type's final flight on 3 Mar 2006; lent to the Aichi Museum of Flight from Nov 2021 to Sep 2022 and returned
